name: Join a Startup Bot
tagline: Brings a handful of startup jobs to your messages every day
description: For anyone trying to get into a company early rather than late. Each day it turns up a small set of roles - somewhere between three and ten - drawn from places the big job boards never index, and sends them straight to your messages. Ask, and it will go further and help you approach the people hiring.
author: Ben
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
